name: Kiyotsu Chizu
source:
[i]"I would've liked to keep going."[/i]

Editor-in-Chief of NK Publishing's digital media department.

A young female Alpha, she's Fuller's top talent and Editor-in-Chief. She's into women, and her hobbies are ceramic art and herbal tea. As is usual for an Alpha, she's incredibly smart and extremely skilled. She has a mild and pleasant temperament and is well-liked and respected among her staff. Although she obligingly helps Rino calm down when she goes into heat, for some reason, she keeps pushing the other woman away...

[Taken from Official website]
